title: Blue Raglan Knit & Concho Belt
prompt: An original young woman with long, straight black hair and side-swept layers wears a brown knit raglan top with a blue swirl motif and blue-and-brown marled sleeves. A black choker and layered silver chain necklaces sit at her throat. A flowing olive-green tiered maxi skirt is cinched with a silver concho chain belt. Her expression is calm and direct. A plain pale gray backdrop with soft light. Palette of chocolate, cerulean blue, olive, and silver. Edgy and bohemian, in the style of an alternative knitwear lookbook.
workingNotes:
- The marled sleeves and concho belt are the defining textures.
- Keep the swirl motif specific to match the knit detail.
tryThis: Try this: Describe the swirl motif precisely.
